narrative: Hawkish BoJ rhetoric drives a JPY bid as Governor Ueda and board member Takata signal imminent rate hikes, with markets now pricing a 97% probability of a September move. USD/JPY retreats to 159.57 despite a 270bp SOFR-TONA carry advantage, while EUR/USD firmed toward 1.1574 on Nagel's hike signals; gold lower -0.58%; equities -0.71%; DXY +0.04%; VIX 16.3. Watch ECB's next move on Sept 10 and the BoJ policy decision on Sept 18.
